bullets.text: Norway is mourning the death of King Harald, with his son Haakon VIII ascending to the throne. The mayor of Oslo called off her wedding ceremony following the king's death.
A necklace containing 600 diamonds was stolen from a museum in Vienna in broad daylight, with police searching for two suspects who are believed to have bought tickets to the exhibition.
Western officials state that Russia is increasing its rhetoric but aims to avoid a direct war with NATO, though they anticipate continued "hybrid activity" against NATO members.
Documents allege a former KPMG partner made "unwanted sexual advances" and treated "female members of staff and clients inappropriately" while at the firm.
A former Paralympic swimmer and a firefighter are among dozens of Australian workers alleging global workers' compensation firm Gallagher Bassett has failed them.
One Nation's influence on Labor's migration policy is under scrutiny following contradictory policy statements regarding immigration and asylum.
Federal Reserve Chair Kevin Warsh indicated that the Fed might raise interest rates if inflation does not decrease, leading to increased market bets on a September rate hike.
US corporate profits have reached a record high, representing the largest share of national income since World War II, while worker payouts have declined.
Economist Gita Gopinath criticized Trump's tariffs as "straight-out protectionism" and discussed the potential threats to the dollar, describing the current economic period as a "great gamble."
